summary: 35-year-old female from Loveland found deceased after an approximate 200-foot tumbling fall just west of Martha's Couloir on Mount Lady Washington; a family member notified park rangers via satellite communication device; RMNP SAR reached the scene by ground with aerial support from the Mesa Verde Interagency Helitak crew; body flown by long-line to Upper Beaver Meadows helipad and transferred to the Boulder County Coroner
location: west of Martha's Couloir, Mount Lady Washington, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue Team; Mesa Verde Interagency Helitak crew
notes: Incident occurred 2021-07-15 per NPS release dated 2021-07-16. User-supplied lead 2026-09-14.
